citation: Polidori et al. 2013. Canagliflozin lowers postprandial glucose and insulin by delaying intestinal glucose absorption in addition to increasing urinary glucose excretion. Diabetes Care 36:2154.
protocol: Placebo or canagliflozin 300 mg 20 min before a 600-kcal mixed-meal tolerance test: 75 g glucose oral solution with 14C-glucose; plasma sampled for 6 h.
population: 20 healthy subjects (per abstract). Baseline demographics are in a table that is an image in the XML and were not read.

reports.marker: plasma glucose incremental AUC 0-1, 0-2 and 0-6 h
total oral glucose absorbed over 0-6 h

note: Glucose and insulin incremental AUCs are printed as arithmetic mean (SD) in text, with placebo and canagliflozin arms; the RaO totals (79 g placebo, 75 g canagliflozin) have no dispersion. Use the placebo arm as the healthy meal reference. Demographics table is an image.
